brand.name: OpticMind Labs
brand.positioning: A precise, composed visual system for intelligent perception products.

guidelines: Use measurable details and operational specifics.
Frame technology as serving people and places.
Avoid vague futurism, fear-based surveillance language, and exaggerated claims.

kintsugiGold.usage: Signature accent, dividers, logo strokes, and key actions

pearl.usage: Primary text on dark, light surface applications

goldSignature.usage: Wordmark text, logo strokes, primary CTAs

accent.name: Cormorant Garamond
accent.usage: Editorial accent and pull quotes only

logo.clearspace: At least one iris-height around the mark

do: Use Obsidian as the dominant canvas.
Use gold sparingly for meaningful signal.
Keep cards and controls at 6px radius.
Use Space Grotesk for display and UI labels.
Use Manrope for readable operational content.
Use thin gold lines to connect sections or show data flow.
dont: Do not use off-palette blues, pastels, or playful gradients.
Do not flood layouts with gold.
Do not blur or lower logo opacity.
Do not use ornate decoration without functional meaning.
Do not use vague futurist or fear-based copy.

agentPrompts.uiImplementation: Use the OpticMind Labs brand kit. Load brand-styles.json and follow skills/opticmind-brand/SKILL.md. Build a dark, precise, operational interface using Obsidian, Graphite panels, sparse Kintsugi Gold accents, Space Grotesk headings, and Manrope body text. Keep radii at 6px, avoid off-palette colors, and reserve gold for signal, dividers, and primary actions.
agentPrompts.copywriting: Write in the OpticMind Labs voice: precise, composed, human. Use specific operational language and measurable outcomes. Avoid hype, vague futurism, fear-based surveillance language, and exaggerated claims.
agentPrompts.visualAsset: Create an OpticMind Labs visual asset using an obsidian background, restrained gold connection lines, engineered composition, and high contrast. Use the eye/iris/hexagon motif only when it clarifies the message. Do not use bright off-brand blues, playful gradients, soft pastel palettes, heavy decoration, or blurred atmospheric stock imagery.
